execution_body_parity.caveat: Through EOT only;post-EOT binary marker/padding bytes are retained but not called identical.

checks.native_patch_retry: Original single-bit seed search stopped before writing/executing a module. V2 adds neighboring bit combinations and stricter descriptor-only normalization; actual policies and all other file bits checked.

decision.reason: No consistent model-sized H2D improvement across reversed phases; small-copy regressions. Keep default ca.ca reads and wb.wb writes. The uc.uc D2D32 gain is standalone and also includes compiler scheduling changes, not a demonstrated model gain.

scope: Standalone v14 native-runtime replay. Cached and each candidate share process,allocations/context,geometry,writepolicy and data. Four sizes,1/32distinctoutputs,H2D/D2D,two overwrittenphases with reversedABBA/BAAB order. Source/timestamp/full per-copy/outer guards checked. No fresh model or physical traffic measurements.
caveats: Baseline is load.ca.ca/store.wb.wb. Non-temporal builtin emits load.uc.uc and also reschedules code. That first comparison is not descriptor-bit-only. NT-store/both candidates are compiled/disassembled but NEVER GPU-executed.

Native level controls change only the decoded cache bits in four load instructions of an isolated eight-export zebin;all other file bits and metadata remain unchanged. Parent cached/L1UC/L1stream execution bodies match1864bytes through EOT. Post-EOT marker/padding bytes are not called identical.

SPIRV cache decorations in three attempted locations bake successfully but emit default ca.ca in this installed pipeline. No GPU benchmarks are run on those unchanged instructions. Native ISA controls bypass that outcome;this is not a claim about every compiler/SPIRV path.

Each variant has16cases x2phases x60samples:discard12warmups,retain48samples/12four-requestcycles per phase. Each cycle compares geometric GPU tick intervals;positive rate change means faster. No calibrated wall-time conversion,confidence interval or significance claim. Host submit/wait spans remain separate.

GPU intervals contain fixed start/end timestamp post-sync commands and initial dispatch state. Preparation,uploads,validation/readback and full-buffer checks are outside timing. GPU clocks unlocked. Compilers,GPU tests and archive work serialize with the shared lease.

No cached-source-query repetition or OpenVINO investigation. Existing v14 library is unchanged;its old general GPU checks are not rerun. These checks cover the new read-cache kernels with exact copy data;they do not prove a model speed gain.

First native patch attempt could not encode uc.ca using only single-bit seeds. It failed before writing or executing a patched module. The preserved V2 searches neighboring bit combinations and verifies exact decoded cache-only changes.

First packaged-clang attempt compiled bitcode but failed textual LLVM IR output before bake/GPU execution. The succeeding attempt inspects actual SPIRV MemoryAccess Nontemporal flags instead. Original failure remains archived.

Concurrent live local-ID,storage/lookup/indirect-payload and MTP work is excluded. No runtime/adapter/production binary/configuration,rootREADME or immutableLinuxhandoff changes. Linux GPU remains deferred.
